Jasprit Bumrah to miss NZ ODIs, focus on Test cricket

Jasprit Bumrah is unlikely to participate in India's upcoming five-match ODI series against New Zealand. The Indian team management is prioritizing his workload for Test cricket, with the aim of preparing him for red-ball matches and the World Test Championship. Despite being fully fit, Bumrah may play one India A match before joining the Test squad. India's ODI and Test squads are expected to be announced soon.
